name: cf-ask
description: Answer questions with evidence. Use when the user asks about project behavior, source code, specs, docs, configuration, dependencies, or external technical information; inspect the repo first, use internet/current docs when repo evidence is insufficient, and ask back only when the question cannot be answered safely. Use when: Invoke to answer project or technical questions with repo-first evidence. A request to fix or change something is still answered without editing any file; point the user to $cf-fix.

findings.excerpt: - The user wants full legacy documentation reconstruction: use `cf-docs --reconstruct` when the optional document bundle is installed; otherwise use `cf-scout`
